title: Defining the Crick-Franklin-Watson genes of any robot (equals a finite state machine) and defining the Shannon genetic code attached to each gene. We also define the Krohn-Rhodes complexity of any regular maximal prefix code
summary: This paper will discuss the relationships among three pillars of mathematics: important research in codes and automata by Marcel-Paul Schutzenberger and others; random walks on finite semigroups by Persi Diaconis and others; and advanced techniques from finite semigroup theory used in proving Krohn-Rhodes complexity c is decidable by Stuart Margolis, Anne Schilling, and myself. Very surprising connections exist between the Fundamental Lemma of Complexity c (epimorphisms between finite semigroups that are one-to-one on subgroups preserve c) and coupling from the past in Markov chains,…
